name: Mixmax
tagline: Mixmax is an email productivity and sales engagement extension for Gmail that adds scheduling, email tracking, sequences, and AI-assisted writing. Its AI draft assistant suggests replies and generates email templates based on context, and one-click polls and scheduling links reduce friction in every conversation. Sales development reps and customer success teams use it to send more personalised outreach at higher volume.
